judgment: It is good to hold firm.
image: Thunder up in heaven: Great Strength.
So the noble one never treads
lines: He is strong in his toes.
The small person uses strength, but the noble one uses a net.
Holding firm: good, and regret is gone.
The fence breaks open, and nothing sticks —
he is strong in the axle of a great cart.
it cannot go back, and cannot push through.

notes.name_en: 大壯 great vigour at its peak; 'Great Strength'.
notes.L5: 易 read as ease ('easily'); the border-ground reading rejected — the point is strength let go without struggle.
